widths.boundary_rule: Source-delimited current domain between 35.25 and 36.25 N based on hydrography and velocity/transport analysis. No universal velocity threshold assumed.
widths.extraction_method: Reported 110 km span transcribed; section limits recorded from prose. No source figure digitized or inferred axis width calculated.
widths.geographic_scope: 24.5 W meridional section, 35.25-36.25 N, ORCA stations 39-55 study. Not a uniform along-route width.
widths.layer: Westward counterflow with subsurface maximum and intermediate-water support; surface altimetry alone does not identify it. About 2000 m vertical extent in source; not uniform width at every depth.
widths.name: Azores Countercurrent
widths.range_interpretation: Source reports a rounded section span without a width uncertainty interval; not seasonal or annual variability.
remaining_gates: Review section boundary, vertical support and figure-caption date discrepancy.
Obtain repeated seasonal sections before annual variability or representative width.
Canonical measurement admission and release review.
widths.section_orientation: Meridional section; not reinterpreted as exact flow-normal span.
widths.source_citation: Comas-Rodriguez et al. (2011), The Azores Current System from a meridional section at 24.5 W, Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans, doi:10.1029/2011JC007129.
widths.source_locator: Abstract [1], Data and Methods [6], current domains [12] and Discussion [15].
widths.source_quality_note: Figure 1 caption says fall 2010, whereas abstract/data text specifies 2009 and detailed station occupation 26 Oct-1 Nov 2009. Follow explicit data text and retain discrepancy pending review.
widths.time_convention: 26 October-1 November 2009 station occupation within ORCA cruise 15 October-11 November 2009; single survey, not autumn climatology.
